description: Vue 3 + Vite SPA, obfuscated automatically via @afterpack/vue (the thin wrapper over @afterpack/vite): Vue Router navigation, a zod-validated form, a reactive() store whose state survives navigation, notes persisted to localStorage, and a lazily loaded report route that reads them through a class with private fields and getters.

build.note: obfuscation runs automatically via @afterpack/vue's closeBundle hook (vite.config.ts) -- no separate step

interactions.description: Reactive counter increments and re-renders on click.
